name: telaris-pcs
description: Telaris PCS MCP servers: tasks, kanban, tags, orders, customers, products, reports and the Telaris documentation.

host.title: PCS hostname

token.title: MCP auth key
token.description: Your personal auth key. Log in to PCS, open /mcp, and copy the key from the install command shown there. Treat it like a password.
